title: Initialize Fedo at app launch
description: In App.init: read FedoAPIKey from Info.plist and call Fedo.initialize(apiKey:config:). Use logLevel .debug in DEBUG builds, .none in release. If key is missing, skip initialize (SDK shows its placeholder) and log a clear hint pointing to Secrets.example.xcconfig. Replace template ContentView hello world.
acceptance_criteria: With key: FeedbacksView loads the board. Without key: app runs, Fedo UI shows placeholder, no crash.
notes: Coordinator 2026-09-15: brb.4 touches only the App entry file (init + key read). Leave ContentView for ywx.3, which owns the root view.
close_reason: Merged to main; build with/without Secrets verified; launch without key verified

title: Load Fedo API key from gitignored Secrets.xcconfig
description:
Never commit the Fedo API key.
- Secrets.xcconfig (gitignored) defines FEDO_API_KEY.
- Secrets.example.xcconfig (committed) with placeholder + comment on where to get a key (getfedo.com dashboard).
- Base config includes Secrets.xcconfig optionally (#include? "Secrets.xcconfig") so fresh clones and CI still build.
- Expose via Info.plist key FedoAPIKey = $(FEDO_API_KEY).
acceptance_criteria: Clean clone builds without Secrets.xcconfig; with it, Bundle.main reads the key; no key in git history.
close_reason: Merged to main; build with/without Secrets verified; launch without key verified

title: Add Xcode .gitignore and untrack xcuserdata
description: xcuserdata/ (UserInterfaceState.xcuserstate, xcschememanagement.plist) is committed. Extend .gitignore with standard Xcode entries (xcuserdata/, DerivedData/, build/, *.xcuserstate) and git rm --cached the tracked user files. Keep the beads entries already in .gitignore.
acceptance_criteria: git ls-files shows no xcuserdata; opening Xcode leaves git status clean.

title: Configure Xcode project: iOS 16 target, Swift 6, pinned FedoKit
description:
Current state: IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET = 26.5, SWIFT_VERSION = 5.0, FedoKit added via kind = branch "0.3.0-beta.1".

- Set deployment target to iOS 16 (FedoKit minimum; showcases widest SDK support).
- Set Swift language mode to 6 (FedoKit requires Swift 6).
- Change FedoKit package requirement to exact version 0.3.0-beta.1 (docs/README use exact, not branch).
- Commit xcshareddata/swiftpm/Package.resolved for reproducible builds.
acceptance_criteria: Project builds and runs on an iOS 16 simulator with Swift 6 mode; pbxproj shows kind = exactVersion; Package.resolved tracked in git.

title: Project setup
description: Get the Xcode project into a correct, reproducible state before any feature work.

title: Manual QA with a real Fedo API key
description: All Fedo flows were verified only without a key (SDK placeholder). Need a real key from the Fedo dashboard in Config/Secrets.xcconfig to verify: board loads in Roadmap tab, create/vote/comment, feedback sheet submit, sign-in migrates guest votes, logout, favorite_provider property visible in dashboard. Requires the user to provide a key.
acceptance_criteria: All Fedo flows work end-to-end with a real key; findings filed as beads.
notes: Unblocked 2026-09-15: owner provided public demo key (committed via Base.xcconfig on task/ci). Posting test feedback on demo board is acceptable.

title: Enable GitHub private vulnerability reporting
description: SECURITY.md and CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md point to https://github.com/getfedo/fedo-ios-example/security/advisories/new, but private vulnerability reporting is disabled on the repo (API returns enabled: false). Maintainer with admin rights: Settings > Code security > Private vulnerability reporting > Enable (or gh api -X PUT repos/getfedo/fedo-ios-example/private-vulnerability-reporting). Needs repo owner approval; outward-facing.
acceptance_criteria: GET /repos/getfedo/fedo-ios-example/private-vulnerability-reporting returns enabled: true; advisory link works.

title: Add MIT LICENSE
description: Add LICENSE (MIT, copyright holder + year 2026). README must note FedoKit binary is distributed under its own license.
design: Decision 2026-09-15: MIT (user agreed). Example code should be freely copyable into apps.
acceptance_criteria: LICENSE file committed; README links it.

title: Settings: demo sign-in/out with Fedo identity
description: Settings screen with a fake sign-in form (name + email, no backend). Sign in: Fedo.setUserID, setUserDisplayName, setUserEmail. Sign out: Fedo.logout(). Persist demo user in @AppStorage. Short explainer text: votes made as guest migrate to the signed-in user.
acceptance_criteria: Vote as guest, sign in, vote still attributed to the signed-in user; sign out starts a fresh anonymous user.
close_reason: Merged to main; Roadmap not-configured state and Settings sign-in/out verified via UI automation on iPhone 17 Pro Max (no key)

title: Contextual feedback sheets: missing model + report problem
description:
Use .presentCreateFeedback(isPresented:) in two places:
- Search/filter empty state: "Missing a model? Request it".
- Fetch error state: "Report a problem".
acceptance_criteria: Both buttons open the submission sheet; binding resets on dismiss and after successful submit.
close_reason: Merged to main; sheet opened from No Results with demo key on iPhone Air; tests pass

title: Roadmap tab: FeedbacksView in its own NavigationStack
description: Root is a TabView (Models / Roadmap / Settings). Roadmap tab = NavigationStack { FeedbacksView() } (documented own-stack pattern). Users vote on app features (compare models, price alerts, favorites).
design: Coordinator 2026-09-15: tab instead of toolbar button to avoid toolbar merge conflicts with search/filter work and give cleaner UX.
acceptance_criteria: Roadmap tab shows the board (or SDK placeholder without key); voting/commenting works with a real key; internal navigation pushes within the tab.
notes: Committed on task/tabs (merge pending with kgd.3). Finding: without an API key FedoKit 0.3.0-beta.1 renders a blank screen, not a visible placeholder; kgd.3 adds an app-level "Fedo not configured" state.
close_reason: Merged to main; Roadmap not-configured state and Settings sign-in/out verified via UI automation on iPhone 17 Pro Max (no key)

title: Fedo SDK integration showcase
description: Wire every public FedoKit API into natural moments of the app so the repo doubles as integration docs. Docs: https://docs.getfedo.com/next/guide/getting-started/

title: Model detail screen
description: Push from list row. Shows name, provider, id (copyable), release date, description, input/output price per 1M, context length, input modalities.
acceptance_criteria: Every list row opens a detail screen with correct data; long descriptions scroll.
close_reason: Merged to main; verified on iPhone 17e with live data

title: Search and provider filter
description: .searchable over name/id. Toolbar menu to filter by provider (derived from loaded models, sorted by count). No results shows empty state (hook for Fedo request sheet in epic 3).
acceptance_criteria: Search and filter combine; clearing both restores the full list.
notes: Group/filter by AIModel.providerID (lowercased id prefix). Some providerIDs map to multiple display names (anthropic: Anthropic/anthropic, mistralai: Mistral/mistralai, x-ai: SpaceXAI/xAI). Pick one label per group: first model whose name has a ": " prefix, else the id prefix.
close_reason: Merged to main; verified search, grouped provider filter, no-results on iPhone Air

title: Latest models list screen
description: NavigationStack list sorted by created (newest first). Row: name, provider, relative date, context length, input price per 1M. States: loading, error (with retry), empty. Pull-to-refresh via .refreshable, load via .task.
acceptance_criteria: List shows newest models first; airplane mode shows error state with retry; pull-to-refresh refetches.
notes: iOS 16 target: ContentUnavailableView is iOS 17+, so build one small shared empty/error view (icon, message, optional action button). Reused by search empty state and Fedo sheets (kgd.2).
close_reason: Merged to main; verified on iPhone Air simulator with live data

title: ModelPulse core app
description: Browse the newest AI models from the public OpenRouter API (GET https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models, no key). Plain URLSession async/await + Decodable, no third-party deps.

title: OpenRouter models API client + model + formatters
description:
- AIModel: Decodable subset of /api/v1/models data[]: id, name, created (unix), description, context_length, pricing.prompt/completion (USD per token, as strings), architecture.input_modalities.
- Provider derived from id prefix before "/" (strip leading "~").
- fetchModels() async throws using URLSession.
- Formatters: price per 1M tokens (Double(price) * 1_000_000, handle "0" as Free and negative/"-1" as variable), context length (e.g. 1M ctx, 128K ctx), relative created date.
acceptance_criteria: Fetching returns ~400+ models decoded without failure; formatters cover free/variable/normal prices.
close_reason: Merged to main; decodes 445 live models; iOS16/Swift6 build clean

title: Report to Fedo SDK team: uninitialized FeedbacksView renders blank
description: FedoKit 0.3.0-beta.1: when Fedo.initialize was never called, FeedbacksView (FedoNotInitializedView) renders an empty white screen with no text or title. Docs (getting-started, feedback-ui) say the iOS UI shows a placeholder. Either render visible guidance (e.g. "Fedo SDK not initialized") or fix docs. Observed on iOS 26.5 simulator in the ModelPulse example. External: file in fedo-ios issues or SDK team tracker.
acceptance_criteria: Issue reported to SDK team (link recorded) or docs corrected.

title: Run app on iOS 16 and iOS 17 simulator runtimes
description: Only iOS 26.5 simulator runtime is installed locally. Deployment target is iOS 16, so API availability issues only show at runtime on old OSes. Install iOS 16/17 runtimes (xcodebuild -downloadPlatform iOS or Xcode Settings > Components) and smoke-test list, detail, Fedo board, sheet, settings.
acceptance_criteria: App launches and core flows work on iOS 16.x and 17.x simulators.

title: GitHub Actions CI: build and test
description: Workflow on push/PR to main: macOS runner with Xcode 26 (check runner image availability), resolve SPM, xcodebuild build + test on iOS simulator. Must pass without Secrets.xcconfig. Cache SPM.
acceptance_criteria: CI green on main; README badge points to it.

title: CONTRIBUTING.md
description: How to build/run (Secrets.xcconfig), run tests, code style (match existing SwiftUI style, no third-party deps), branch + PR flow, issue tracking with bd (beads), where to report Fedo SDK bugs (fedo-ios repo) vs example app bugs.
acceptance_criteria: Covers setup, tests, PR flow; linked from README.

title: CHANGELOG.md
description: Keep a Changelog format with Unreleased section. Decide versioning: own semver for the example app, noting which FedoKit version each release targets.
acceptance_criteria: CHANGELOG exists and lists features at first release.

title: README.md
description: Sections: what this is (Fedo iOS example: ModelPulse), screenshots, requirements (Xcode 26, iOS 16+, Swift 6), quick start (clone, copy Secrets.example.xcconfig, add key, run), "Where Fedo is used" table linking to exact files, data source credit (OpenRouter), links to getfedo.com + docs + fedo-ios, license (MIT). Badges: CI, license, platform.
acceptance_criteria: New dev goes from clone to running app using only README; every Fedo API in the table links to real code.
notes:
Coordinator: README must state the Fedo API key is a client-side key embedded in the app bundle (Info.plist) - not a server secret; Secrets.xcconfig only keeps it out of git.
README: app ships with a public demo Fedo key (demo board, anyone can post); explain how to use your own key via Config/Secrets.xcconfig.

title: Capture screenshots and demo GIF
description: Simulator screenshots (light + dark): list, detail, roadmap board, feedback sheet, settings. Short GIF of guest vote then sign-in. Store in docs/images/, compressed.
acceptance_criteria: Images under ~500KB each and referenced by README.
notes: Screenshots can now show real Fedo board/sheet using the demo key.

title: GitHub repo docs and health
description: Files and config GitHub community standards expect, so the example is easy to find, run and contribute to.

title: User property: favorite_provider
description: When user picks a provider filter, call Fedo.setUserProperty("favorite_provider", value:). Add a one-line code comment that properties are user-level and last value wins.
acceptance_criteria: Picking a provider updates the property (visible with logLevel .debug and in dashboard).
notes: Group/filter by AIModel.providerID (lowercased id prefix). Some providerIDs map to multiple display names (anthropic: Anthropic/anthropic, mistralai: Mistral/mistralai, x-ai: SpaceXAI/xAI). Pick one label per group: first model whose name has a ": " prefix, else the id prefix.
close_reason: Merged to main; sheet opened from No Results with demo key on iPhone Air; tests pass

title: Unit test target: decoding + formatters
description: Add a test target. Tests: decode a small checked-in JSON fixture (copy of a few real OpenRouter entries incl. free and variable pricing); price per 1M formatting; context length formatting; provider parsing. No network in tests.
acceptance_criteria: xcodebuild test passes locally; breaking a formatter makes a test fail.
close_reason: Merged to main; xcodebuild test: 20 cases passed on iPhone 17 sim

title: Error-state buttons should stack vertically at large Dynamic Type
description: ModelsListView error StatusView puts Retry and Report a Problem in an HStack; at accessibility text sizes labels wrap inside buttons. Use ViewThatFits (iOS 16) to fall back to VStack.
acceptance_criteria: At AX5 text size both buttons are fully readable.

title: Surface failed pull-to-refresh when models are already shown
description: ModelsListView keeps the list when a refresh fails (good) but shows nothing, so the user cannot tell the refresh failed. Minimal fix: a small inline banner/footer or alert with the error message.
acceptance_criteria: Failed refresh with data present shows a non-blocking error indication.

title: Decide Code of Conduct enforcement contact
description: CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md routes conduct reports to the GitHub security advisory form, which is meant for vulnerabilities. Consider a dedicated conduct address (e.g. a team alias) once one exists; no personal emails in public files.
acceptance_criteria: CoC contact is a channel intended for conduct reports.

title: Share the Xcode scheme for CI
description: No shared .xcscheme exists; Xcode autogenerates fedo-ios-example scheme locally. CI (x05.8) and test plans need xcshareddata/xcschemes/fedo-ios-example.xcscheme committed (mark Shared in Xcode or create file).
acceptance_criteria: xcshareddata/xcschemes/fedo-ios-example.xcscheme tracked; xcodebuild -list on clean clone shows scheme with test action.
close_reason: Merged to main; xcodebuild test: 20 cases passed on iPhone 17 sim

acceptance_criteria: Tag pushed; release page matches CHANGELOG.
notes: Coordinator 2026-09-15: feature agents do NOT edit CHANGELOG.md (avoids merge conflicts). At release, compile Unreleased entries from git log (Refs: bead ids).
